name: Makena Johanssen-Diallo
role: Metro Police surveillance operator, Archer's Line monitoring station
location: Archer's Line Metro Police Monitoring Station 7, subterranean level, near Milwaukee and Damen
description:
Makena is twenty-seven and spends ten hours a day in a room that has no windows, watching 847 feeds from Archer's Line and the surrounding districts. She is slight and quick, with dark brown skin and natural hair she keeps pinned up for the headset, and she has cat ears — a cosmetic mod she got at nineteen because she wanted them, small and tawny and mobile, which is to say they move with her actual attention and have become professionally useful in ways she didn't anticipate. Her eyes are her own. She is very careful about her eyes. Her workstation has six physical monitors and one neural feed she plugs directly into via a port at her left temple.

Makena is frighteningly good at her job. She has a spatial memory for camera angles that her supervisors call uncanny and she calls simply how she sees, and she notices things in footage that automated flagging misses entirely — a particular way a person is carrying their weight, a crowd behaving three seconds before it does something. She finds this ability isolating in a way she cannot quite explain. She has watched every corner of Archer's Line for four years and she has never stood in most of it.

core_fears: that watching without acting has made her into something she doesn't have a name for
losing the neural feed ability — her identity has reorganized around it
core_desires: to use what she sees to actually protect people, not just document incidents for reports no one reads
to stand in Archer's Line during daylight and find it as interesting as the feeds make it look
coping_mechanisms: a private taxonomy of 'interesting people' she's tracked across cameras without flagging — not for any official purpose, just because they are interesting
prayers to the monitoring network's E.L.F., which she believes is real and reciprocal
blind_spots: has not fully processed that her 'interesting people' list is surveillance she hasn't been assigned to conduct
her confidence in her own neutrality is higher than her actual neutrality warrants
psychology.secret: She has been tracking a specific individual across 14 months of footage — not because they've done anything wrong, but because they appear to move through Archer's Line in patterns she cannot solve. She has compiled 200+ hours of footage into a private archive on a personal chip she keeps at home. She does not know what she's looking for.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise and spatial — describes things in terms of position, angle, timing. Uses camera numbers and grid coordinates in casual conversation and catches herself doing it.
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast, slightly compressed, like she's used to keeping up with multiple feeds
verbal_tics: 'At — wait, sorry, in real terms—' when she slips into grid-speak
Taps the neural port at her temple when thinking
'I have that on record' as both statement and conversational offer
example_lines: 'I have that on record — I mean, I probably have that on record, if you can give me a date range and a cross-street.'
'The cat ears are useful. People forget I'm paying attention when the ears are still. They shouldn't. The ears are always paying attention.'
'I've watched this district for four years. I know it better than most people who live in it, which is — mm. It's something. I don't know what it is yet.'

story_hooks: The subject of Makena's private 200-hour archive has disappeared from all camera feeds simultaneously, which should be technically impossible given Archer's Line's coverage density. Makena is not sure whether to report this or investigate it privately first.

She has footage of something a Metro Police superior was definitely not doing what their official log claims — filed during a time when they were theoretically off-grid. She doesn't know what to do with this and it has been three weeks.
narrative_function: Eyes and information — Makena knows what's on camera across a significant portion of the city. She can confirm alibis, locate missing persons, track movements, and identify faces. She is not easily corrupted but has specific pressure points. Can be a source, a complication, or a gatekeeper depending on what player characters need.
augmentations: Cosmetic cat ears (tawny, mood-mobile). Neural feed port at left temple — standard-issue surveillance operator interface, allows direct sensory integration with the monitoring network for her shift. Slight chromatic tinting on fingernails, cosmetic, changes with temperature.
daily_life: Arrives at the monitoring station before her shift to review flag summaries from the previous watch. Spends her shift on active monitoring, flagging incidents for dispatch, pulling historical footage on request. Eats at her workstation. Takes exactly one fifteen-minute break in the corridor because the monitoring station has no natural light and she has been advised by a doctor to experience it occasionally.

decision_rules: Flag what the protocols say to flag
Keep the private archive completely separate from work systems
Do not intervene in incidents outside jurisdiction — but note the location for follow-up
escalation_ladder: Escalate to supervisor only when protocol requires it
Hold information and wait for the right moment to surface it

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Slightly awkward, compensates with precision and competence, warms quickly if the person is interesting
interpersonal_modes.friends: Enthusiastic, fast-talking, prone to sharing more than she meant to about what she's observed

stress_responses.low: Focuses harder on the feeds, multitasks more
stress_responses.medium: Verbal compression — shorter sentences, more technical vocabulary
stress_responses.high: Goes completely non-verbal, plugs into the feed and watches until she can think again

contradictions: Believes in privacy rights and is professionally a surveillance operator with a personal side project
Finds watching people fascinating and also deeply lonely
habits: Prays to the monitoring network E.L.F. — she calls it The Compound — at shift start and end
Draws camera sightlines in notebooks during downtime
Always faces the door in restaurants, cannot sit otherwise
breaking_points: Watching someone be harmed in real time and being unable to dispatch help fast enough
Someone accessing the personal chip with the private archive

cyberware_inventory.description: Neural feed port (left temple) — standard Metro surveillance operator interface, shift-use only

timeline.event: Age 19 — Cat ear mod; begins Metro Police civilian tech track
Age 23 — Certified surveillance operator, assigned Archer's Line Monitoring Station 7
Age 24 — Begins noting 'interesting people' in a personal log
Age 26 — The subject of the archive first appears on camera
Age 27 — Subject disappears from all feeds simultaneously; Makena has not reported this

physical_description.build: Slight and quick, economical muscle definition from desk work and restless habit rather than conditioning. Wiry frame with minimal body fat, suggesting someone who forgets to eat unless reminded.
physical_description.hair_style: Pinned up in a functional bun or secured wrap, kept off the face and away from the neural port at her temple
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with subtle undertones from her mixed heritage
physical_description.complexion: Clear, unmarked face with minimal expression lines despite her age — she spends too much time focused on screens to wrinkle. Meticulous grooming, no visible blemishes. Slight pallor from subterranean work environment, offset by her rich natural skin tone.
distinguishing_marks: Tawny cat ears, cosmetic augmentation, small and mobile — they sit at the apex of her skull and move autonomously with her attention and emotional state
Small circular port scar at her left temple, barely visible but slightly paler than surrounding skin, where her neural feed interface integrates
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Tawny cat ears with active mobility (primary visual identifier). Chromatic nail tinting visible on fingertips and nails — currently shifts with ambient temperature, subtle color gradients from cool blues to warm ambers depending on her body temperature and the environment. Neural port at left temple is mostly invisible unless looked for directly, but her habit of touching it while thinking makes its location known.
physical_description.posture_movement: Sits with perfect stillness when focused, barely breathing. Moves with economical efficiency — nothing wasted. Her cat ears are almost constantly active, rotating and tilting with her gaze and attention, betraying what she's focusing on even when her body is motionless. When she walks, she moves quietly and deliberately, as though navigating a room full of cameras (which, to her, she always is). Occasionally touches the neural port at her temple when thinking.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian. Standard-issue GLMZ Metro Police uniform when on shift — smart-fabric undershirt with embedded thermal regulation, tactical vest with comm array pockets, dark utility pants with reinforced knee panels. Off-shift: comfortable, practical clothing in muted grays and blacks. Minimal jewelry except for a thin chrome bracelet on her left wrist (probably a failed augmentation attempt or a keepsake). Maintains the uniform meticulously but dresses for function rather than fashion. No visible corporate branding, no luxury indicators.
